Opcode 0x99 — coda (skip-to marker for D.C. al coda)

Opcode 0xC0 — enable reverb send for channel
Opcode 0xC1 — disable reverb send for channel
Opcode 0xC8 — set release portion of envelope
Opcode 0xD0 — set absolute pitch bend
Opcode 0xD1 — add-pitch-bend handler.
Opcode 0xE0 — dynamics handler (channel velocity scalar).

Opcode 0xE1 — relative dynamics add. v = (sb_param << 24) + chan+0x98, clamp positive, store back. Also clears chan+0x6 bit 0x8 (disarms any in-flight expression burst) and sets vol-prestage. Jumptable @0x80028C90.

Opcode 0xE2 — expression handler (timed volume ramp). Computes per-tick delta = ((sb_target<<24) - chan+0x98) / seed, stores in chan+0xa0; seeds chan+0xa8 = seed; sets chan+0x6 bit 0x8 to arm the per-tick ramp. Jumptable @0x80028C94. (Ghidra's pre-fix annotation said 0xE1; the dispatcher arithmetic at PC 0x800154e4 with base 0x80028b0c proves 0xE2.)

Opcode 0xE3 — sets a fixed vol-scale divisor. Computes scale = 0x100/(param[0]+1) and stores to chan+0x118 / chan+0x11a. No FFT readers of those fields traced; appears to be parity-shadow state. Jumptable @0x80028C98.
